description: The pie chart is divided into six segments, each representing a different category related to the Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge. The categories are Uncrushable, Complexity, Instance, Unhackable, Scalable Oversight, and Coverage. Each segment is color-coded and labeled with a corresponding icon. The Uncrushable segment is yellow with a ladder icon, Complexity is orange with a gear icon, Instance is blue with a shield icon, Unhackable is light blue with a lock icon, Scalable Oversight is red with a checklist icon, and Coverage is green with a globe icon. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific segments. The segments are not ordered in any particular way, such as descending size.
